entry.bio: A student of R. Abuha and a colleague of R. Zera, R Yirmeyah was known for his humility as well as his exacting and outlandish questions. The latter got to the point where he was removed from the academy.

era.label: Active in the fourth century CE; broad period, not a lifespan.
